description: Pedestrian Network is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The Pedestrian Network (pednet) was created by the DAV team at the City of Toronto, and it is based on the sidewalk inventory from Transportation Services, Toronto road centrelines, and manual collection from aerial imagery. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. It offers 16 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, PDF, SHP. The portal shows 2026-02-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
